description:
Sleep-mode config for a project, after the cluster default is merged in.

This doubles as the runtime object callers use: ``matches(name)`` answers whether
a deployment is in scope, and the parsed durations drive the deadlines.

description.description: Explanatory text shown on the waker page.
description.title: Description

enabled.description: Whether sleep-mode is active for this project.
enabled.title: Enabled

match.description: Which deployments are in scope, by name: an exact name, 'prefix*' (starts with) or '*suffix' (ends with). Anything else is refused.
match.title: Match

sleep-after-deploy.description: How long a deployment stays awake after being deployed before it is put to sleep, as a compact duration (48h, 90m, 30s, 2d).
sleep-after-deploy.title: Sleep-After-Deploy

sleep-after-wake.description: How long a deployment stays awake after being woken, same duration format.
sleep-after-wake.title: Sleep-After-Wake

title.description: Heading on the waker page; the deployment name when left out.
title.title: Title

wake-mode.description: What the waker does with a visitor: 'auto' wakes on the first browser GET, 'confirm' shows a button first, 'manual' only informs.
wake-mode.title: Wake-Mode

waker.description: Run a small waker pod in front of a sleeping deployment so a visitor can wake it. Off means only an admin can wake it, via the portal or the API.
waker.title: Waker

waker-component.description: Which component the waker answers for; by default the deployment's root component.
waker-component.title: Waker-Component

title: SleepModeConfig
